tasks.title: Log each day's harvest per orchard block

messages.text: Brief: each farm in the cooperative records picked crates per orchard block on paper. Record them in the app, per farm, so each farm sees its own harvest by block and variety.
Plan: a harvest entry per block per day with variety and crate count, a daily total per farm, and a season view by variety. Tests for totals and a block with no picking.
Resumed after recreating the development database from the seed; the nightly cleanup had removed it.
Delivered: PR #601 merged. Farms log crates per block per day and see their own season totals by variety.

messages.text: Brief: visitors turn up all at once on sunny weekends. Let them book a one-hour pick-your-own slot online, and let staff check them in on the field tablet.

Plan: hourly slots per farm with a visitor limit, online booking, and a check-in list on the field tablet that works offline and syncs when back in signal. Tests for a full slot and an offline check-in.
Delivered: PR #603 merged. Visitors book hourly pick-your-own slots; staff check them in on the field tablet, offline if needed. One finding left open: offline sync conflicts.
Is this on the farm shop till now, or do I have to press update on it? The report doesn't say.
It's merged but the till only takes it when someone presses update in its settings. Press update once and the slot bookings appear.
